items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And so Patrick and I have known each other for a long time... So we’re doing a project together... I know you’re working with Patrick.

ctx.x: Right. And so Patrick and I have known each other for a long time. In the 60s he was the guy who first told me to take this cord and plug it here when I wanted to learn what a Moog synthesizer was about. So we’re doing a project together, just totally on spec which is kind of a piano concerto orchestral format where the orchestra is synthesized. And we’re having a ball. It’s my first big foray back into electronics in many years.
Yeah. The toys have changed a lot.
